miracles.title: The Miracle of the Temple Wheel
miracles.description: The mysterious tale of how the stone wheel atop the Jagannath Temple rotated on its own during a solar eclipse.
miracles.author: Jagannath Tales Team
miracles.imageAlt: Stone wheel (Chakra) atop the Jagannath Temple

content.text: The Jagannath Temple in Puri is crowned with a massive stone wheel known as the Sudarshana Chakra. This sixteen-spoked wheel, weighing several tons, sits atop the temple spire and is visible from miles away.

In the year 1985, during a solar eclipse, thousands of devotees gathered around the temple witnessed an extraordinary phenomenon. As the moon began to cover the sun, the massive stone wheel began to rotate on its axis, defying all laws of physics.

The rotation was slow but unmistakable. The stone wheel, which had been stationary for centuries, moved clockwise for the duration of the eclipse. Temple priests, scientists, and skeptics alike were left astounded by the phenomenon that had no scientific explanation.

content.caption: Artist's depiction of the rotating Chakra during the eclipse

content.text: What made this miracle even more remarkable was that the wheel stopped its rotation precisely when the eclipse ended. Multiple witnesses, including several scientists who happened to be present, documented the event.

miracles.title: The Healing Touch of Mahaprasad
miracles.description: The miraculous healing experienced by a terminally ill devotee after consuming Lord Jagannath's blessed food.
miracles.author: Jagannath Tales Team

content.text: Mahaprasad, the sacred food offered to Lord Jagannath, is believed to possess divine healing properties. Cooked in the world's largest kitchen within the temple premises, this blessed food has been associated with numerous miracles over the centuries.
One such miracle occurred in the life of Ramachandra Das, a devoted follower of Lord Jagannath who was diagnosed with terminal cancer in 1998. Doctors had given him just three months to live.

miracles.title: Divine Protection During the 1999 Cyclone
miracles.description: How the temple city of Puri was miraculously spared from the worst effects of the 1999 super cyclone.
miracles.author: Jagannath Tales Team
miracles.imageAlt: Jagannath Temple standing unharmed amid cyclone destruction

content.text: In October 1999, a super cyclone ravaged the eastern coast of India, causing unprecedented destruction across the state of Odisha. With wind speeds exceeding 250 kmph and a devastating storm surge, it was one of the most destructive cyclones ever recorded in the North Indian Ocean.
Meteorologists had predicted that Puri, being directly in the cyclone's path, would face the full fury of the storm. However, something remarkable happened as the cyclone approached the holy city.
